name: exists_mul_principal
summary: Classes of the h_K + 1 ideals I_i in a group of order h_K: two coincide, c(I_i) = c(I_j) with i ≠ j, and then c(I_i)·c(J_j) = c(I_j)·c(J_j) = 1.

steps.claim: For a finite place v of K let c(v) ∈ Cl(K) be the ideal class of the nonzero prime ideal v.
steps.lean: let c (v : FinPlace K) := mk0 ⟨_, mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero v.3⟩

steps.claim: For finite places v, w of K: v·w is principal if and only if c(v)·c(w) = 1 in the class group.
steps.lean: have e v w : _ ↔ c v * c w = 1 := by rw [← map_mul, mk0_eq_one_iff]

steps.claim: The h_K + 1 classes c(I_i) lie in a group of order h_K, so c(I_i) = c(I_j) for some i ≠ j (pigeonhole); since I_j·J_j is principal (H), c(I_i)·c(J_j) = c(I_j)·c(J_j) = 1, so I_i·J_j is principal.
